subject: Quick note about classwork
text: Hi neighbor, Sorry to send this so quickly—I'm juggling dinner and a printing error. As a customer of your weekend reading club, I wanted to thank you for helping me look over the classwork packet for my son. At first I thought the missing worksheet would hurt his project score, but when I checked the portal, he unexpectedly landed on the honors list. It turns out the extra reading you suggested made the difference. I still don't fully understand how the bonus points worked, but the good result is real. If you ever want the study binder, I can drop it off tomorrow. Also, could you remind me which chapter we're supposed to review before Friday? My head is spinning, and I want to stay on track. Sorry again for the rushed message.
